name: DataGridEmptyState
purpose: Table-row empty state for no-data and no-match grid outcomes.

guidance.useWhen: Use when the grid has no data or when active search/filter criteria produce no matching rows.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for loading and error conditions.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Set hasQuery when the empty result is caused by search or filtering; keep loading and error states separate.

accessibility: Renders the shared EmptyState inside a table row; title and description distinguish no-data from no-match states through hasQuery.
knownLimitations: Use for no-data or no-match states; do not use it for loading or load errors.
